title: 2020 AMC 10B Problem 20
statement: Let \(B\) be a right rectangular prism (box) with edge lengths \(1,\) \(3,\) and \(4,\) together with its interior. For real \(r\geq0,\) let \(S(r)\) be the set of points in \(3\)-dimensional space that lie within a distance \(r\) of some point in \(B.\) The volume of \(S(r)\) can be expressed as \[ar^{3} + br^{2} + cr +d,\] where \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c,\) and \(d\) are positive real numbers. What is \(\dfrac{bc}{ad}?\)

solutions.text:
Decompose \(S(r)\) by where the added volume lies relative to the box.

The original box has volume \(d=1\cdot3\cdot4=12.\) The face slabs contribute surface area times \(r,\) so \[c=2(1\cdot3+1\cdot4+3\cdot4)=38.\]

Along each edge is a quarter-cylinder of radius \(r.\) The sum of all edge lengths is \(4(1+3+4)=32,\) so \[b=\frac14\pi\cdot 32=8\pi.\] At the eight corners, the eighth-spheres combine to one full sphere, so \[a=\frac43\pi.\]

Therefore \[\frac{bc}{ad}=\frac{(8\pi)(38)}{(\frac43\pi)(12)}=19.\]

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Decompose the enlarged solid into the original box, face slabs, edge quarter-cylinders, and corner eighth-spheres
The coefficient of \(r^2\) comes from one quarter-cylinder along each edge
